transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I do have a few questions. First, I was wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a great question! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for a full month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful to know. I was also wondering when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Good question! It's safe to continue using your eye drops or gel for dry eyes. If you were using them before your operation, you can go ahead and use them again unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you're running low, your GP should be able to provide more for you.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's great to hear. I have another question—I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It's quite normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you're outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to assess that further. Do you have any redness or pain along with the light sensitivity?

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, thankfully no redness or pain, just sensitivity. I have one last question—should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. It's quite common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

How long ago was your surgery? That'll help me give you better guidance on whether what you're experiencing is normal.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: My surgery was about a week ago. But based on what you said, it sounds like things are going as expected. I don't have any more questions, thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Brilliant! So just to confirm—have all your questions been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, everything's been answered. Thanks again for your assistance!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! Take care, and wishing you a smooth recovery.
